label: sim-attendance-struggling-2
source: simulated demo student (persona: struggling) run through the real platform

viva.summary: The student understands the overall purpose of the function but misinterpreted the conditional logic; they correctly predicted output and proposed the right modification, though with some uncertainty.

rubric.revise_next: Review how the if‑condition works and practice explaining it clearly before moving on to other changes.

questions.answer: Yeh line check karti hai ke rec.attendance 80 se zyada hai ya nahin, aur agar zyada hai to usse list se hata deti hai. Yeh condition zaroori hai kyunki sirf high attendance wale ko hi remove karna hota hai.
questions.feedback: Your explanation of the if‑statement is reversed; it should filter low attendance, not high.
questions.prompt: What does the line `if (rec.attendance < 80) {` accomplish in your function, and why is this condition necessary?

questions.answer: Yeh code sirf un logon ke naam print karega jinka attendance 80 se kam hai, is liye agar ek record 80% aur doosra 79% ka hai to output sirf 79% wala naam hoga. (Yahan 80% ko include nahi kiya gaya hai).
questions.feedback: Correctly predicted that only the 79% name will be printed.
questions.prompt: What will be printed when you run the code with the input array containing a record with exactly 80% attendance and another with 79%?

questions.answer: Mujhe lagta hai condition ko 'rec.attendance <= 80' karna hoga, is se 80% wale bhi include ho jayenge, lekin main sure nahin hoon ki array ka length sahi check ho raha hai ya nahin.
questions.feedback: You identified the right change (<= 80) but expressed unnecessary doubt about array length.
questions.prompt: Suppose you also need to include students whose attendance is exactly 80% in the short list. How would you modify the condition in your function to achieve this?

messages.body: Ustaad, mujhe lagta hai loop sahi hai lekin answer galat aa raha hai. Hint dein?
Aap ne `recors[i]` likha hai jo undefined variable hai, isliye code ruk jaata hai. Is typo ko theek karne se loop sahi se chalega. Ab aap is choti si mistake ko dhoond kar fix karenge?
messages.hint: Variable names must match exactly; a misspelled name causes a ReferenceError before the loop logic runs.
